   <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">1.</em> Nature of Business and Organization </b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">AvePoint, Inc. (collectively with its subsidiaries, hereinafter referred to as &#8220;<i><b>AvePoint</b></i>,&#8221; the &#8220;<i><b>Company</b></i>,&#8221; &#8220;<i><b>we</b></i>,&#8221; &#8220;<i><b>us</b></i>,&#8221; or &#8220;<i><b>our</b></i>&#8221;) was incorporated as a New Jersey corporation on <em style="font: inherit;"> July 24, 2001 </em>and redomiciled as a Delaware corporation in <em style="font: inherit;">2006.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">Our principal executive headquarters is located in Jersey City, New Jersey, and our principal operating headquarters is located in Richmond, Virginia. We have&#160;additional offices in North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and the Middle East.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">AvePoint is a global provider of modern data protection, enabling organizations to secure, govern, and operationalize data at scale across major cloud ecosystems. Customers rely on the AvePoint Confidence Platform to reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and accelerate digital transformation as they adopt cloud collaboration and artificial intelligence (&#8220;<i><b>AI</b></i>&#8221;)-driven advanced tools and workflows.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">AvePoint&#8217;s common stock is listed on The Nasdaq Global Select Market&#160;(&#8220;<i><b>Nasdaq</b></i>&#8221;) under the symbol &#8220;AVPT&#8221;. On <em style="font: inherit;"> September 18, 2025, </em>AvePoint completed a secondary listing of its common stock on the Main Board of Singapore Exchange Securities Trading Limited&#160;(the &#8220;<i><b>SGX-ST</b></i>&#8221;) under the symbol&#160;&#8220;AVP&#8221;.</p>

   <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">2.</em> Summary of Significant Accounting Policies </b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><i><b></b></i></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" name="us-gaap:BasisOfAccountingPolicyPolicyTextBlock" id="c145104507" escape="true"><p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; "><i><b>Basis of Presentation </b></i></span></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">The accompanying unaudited condensed consolidated balance sheet as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025, </em>which has been derived from audited financial statements, and the unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements have been prepared pursuant to the rules and regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;<i><b>SEC</b></i>&#8221;)&#65279; for interim financial information and include the accounts of the Company and entities consolidated under the variable interest and voting models. All intercompany transactions and balances have been eliminated. Certain information and disclosures normally included in consolidated financial statements prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the U.S. (&#8220;<i><b>GAAP</b></i>&#8221;) have been condensed or omitted.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">In the opinion of management, these financial statements contain all material adjustments, consisting of normal recurring accruals, necessary to present fairly the financial position, results of operations and cash flows for the periods indicated. Operating results for the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">three</em>&#160;months&#160;ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>&#160;are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> necessarily indicative of the results that <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be&#160;expected for any other interim period or for the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2026.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">These condensed consolidated financial statements should be read in conjunction with our&#160;audited consolidated financial statements&#160;and the related notes included in our most recent&#160;Annual Report on Form <em style="font: inherit;">10</em>-K for the year ended&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, which was filed with the SEC on <em style="font: inherit;"> February 26, 2026&#160;(&#8220;</em><b><i>Annual Report</i></b>&#8221;).</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><i></i></b></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" name="avpt:RecentlyAdoptedAccountingGuidancePolicyTextBlock" id="c145104509" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Recently Adopted Accounting Guidance</span></i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> July 2025, </em>the FASB issued Accounting Standards Update (&#8220;<i><b>ASU</b></i>&#8221;) <em style="font: inherit;">No.</em> <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">05,</em> &#8220;Financial Instruments &#8211; Credit Losses (Topic <em style="font: inherit;">326</em>): Measurement of Credit Losses for Accounts Receivable and Contract Assets&#8221; (&#8220;<i><b>ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">05</em></b></i>&#8221;). This ASU introduces a practical expedient that allows entities to assume that current conditions as of the balance sheet date will <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> change for the remaining life of the asset when estimating expected credit losses for current accounts receivable and current contract assets. We adopted the guidance in ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">05</em> effective <em style="font: inherit;"> January 1, 2026, </em>using the required prospective transition approach. The adoption of this standard did <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> have a material impact on our condensed consolidated financial statements and related disclosures.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><i></i></b></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" name="us-gaap:UseOfEstimates" id="c145104510" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Use of Estimates</span></i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">The preparation of condensed consolidated financial statements in conformity with GAAP requires management to make estimates and assumptions that affect the amounts reported in our condensed consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes. We base our estimates and assumptions on historical experience and on various other assumptions that we believe are reasonable under the circumstances. The amounts of assets and liabilities reported&#160;and the amounts of revenue and expenses reported for each of the&#160;periods presented are affected by estimates and assumptions, which are used for, but <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> limited to, the accounting for the determination of standalone selling price for revenue recognition,&#160;deferred contract costs, valuation of goodwill and other intangible assets, income taxes and related reserves, stock-based compensation&#160;and purchase price in a business combination. Actual results and outcomes <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>differ from management&#8217;s estimates and assumptions due to risks and uncertainties.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;"></p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><i><b></b></i></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" name="us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsPolicyTextBlock" id="c145104511" escape="true"><p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; "><i><b>Cash and Cash Equivalents </b></i></span></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">The Company maintains cash and cash equivalents&#160;with several high credit-quality financial institutions. The Company considers its investments with original maturities of <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> months or less to be cash equivalents. These investments are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> subject to significant market risk. The Company maintains its cash and cash equivalents in bank accounts which, at times, exceed the federally insured limits. The Company has <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> experienced any losses in such accounts. The Company maintains cash balances used in operations at entities based in countries that impose regulations that limit the ability to transfer cash out of the country. As of <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>&#160;and <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the Company&#8217;s cash balances at these entities were $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100601" contextRef="i_2026-03-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:Cash" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">20.3</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million&#160;and $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100602" contextRef="i_2025-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:Cash" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">20.0</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million, respectively. For purposes of the condensed consolidated statements of cash flows, cash includes all amounts in the condensed consolidated balance sheets captioned cash and cash equivalents.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;"></p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><i><b></b></i></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationsPolicy" id="c145104512" escape="true"><p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; "><i><b>Business Combination</b></i></span></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">When we consummate a business combination, the assets acquired&#160;and the liabilities assumed are recognized separately from goodwill at their acquisition date fair values. Goodwill as of the acquisition date is measured as the excess of the fair value of consideration transferred over the acquisition date fair value of the net identifiable assets acquired. While best estimates and assumptions are used to accurately value assets acquired and liabilities assumed at the acquisition date as well as contingent consideration, where applicable, our estimates are inherently uncertain and subject to refinement. As a result, during the measurement period, which&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> may&#160;</em>be up to&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">one</em>&#160;year from the acquisition date, we record adjustments to the assets acquired and liabilities assumed with the corresponding offset to goodwill as we obtain new information about facts and circumstances that existed as of the acquisition date that, if known, would have affected the measurement of the amounts recognized as of that date. Upon the earlier of the conclusion of the measurement period or final determination of the values of assets acquired or liabilities assumed, any subsequent adjustments are recorded in the condensed consolidated statements of income.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><i><b></b></i></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" name="us-gaap:GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsGoodwillPolicy" id="c145104513" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; "><b>Goodwill</b></span></i></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;"><em style="font: inherit;">No</em> events or circumstances have changed since any of our&#160;acquisitions that would indicate that the fair value of our reporting unit is below its carrying amount. <ix:nonFraction id="c145100606" contextRef="i_2026-03-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:GoodwillImpairedAccumulatedImpairmentLoss" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="-3">No</ix:nonFraction> impairment was deemed necessary as of <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>&#160;or&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;"></p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><b><i></i></b></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" name="us-gaap:DeferredChargesPolicyTextBlock" id="c145104514" escape="true"><p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><b><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Deferred Contract Costs </span></i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">We defer sales commissions that are considered to be incremental and recoverable costs of obtaining or renewing SaaS, term license and support, and services contracts. Changes in the anticipated period of asset benefit or the average renewal term are recognized on a prospective basis upon occurrence.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">Amortization of deferred contract costs of $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100610" contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostAmortization" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">6.3</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million&#160;for the <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> months&#160;ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>, and&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c145100614" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-03-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostAmortization" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">5.5</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million for the <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> ended&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2025</em>,&#160;is included as a component of sales and marketing expenses in our&#160;condensed consolidated statements of income.</p>
   <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&#160;</p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left"></p>
   <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left"><b><i></i></b></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" name="us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementPolicyPolicyTextBlock" id="c145104515" escape="true"><p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left"><b><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Fair Value Measurement</span></i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">Fair value is the price that would be received upon selling an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date. Assets and liabilities recorded at fair value are measured and classified in accordance with a <em style="font: inherit;">three</em>-level fair value hierarchy that prioritizes the inputs used to measure fair value. The hierarchy requires entities to maximize the use of observable inputs and minimize the use of unobservable inputs. The <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> levels of inputs used to measure fair value are as follows:</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px;"><tbody><tr style="vertical-align: top;"><td style="width: 42px;">&#160;</td><td style="width: 28px;"> <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size: 10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#8226;</p> </td><td style="width: 1677px;"> <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Level <em style="font: inherit;">1</em> &#8212;&#160;Quoted prices (unadjusted) in active markets for identical assets or liabilities that the reporting entity can access at the measurement date.</p> </td></tr>
<tr><td style="width: 42px;">&#160;</td><td style="width: 28px; font-size: 10pt;">&#8226;</td><td style="width: 1677px; font-size: 10pt;">Level <em style="font: inherit;">2</em> &#8212;&#160;Inputs other than quoted prices included within Level&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">1</em> that are observable for the asset or liability, either directly or indirectly.</td></tr>
<tr><td style="width: 42px;">&#160;</td><td style="width: 28px; font-size: 10pt;">&#8226;</td><td style="width: 1677px; font-size: 10pt;">Level <em style="font: inherit;">3</em> &#8212;&#160;Unobservable inputs for the asset or liability.</td></tr>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><i><b></b></i></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" name="us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerPolicyTextBlock" id="c145104516" escape="true"><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; "><i><b>Revenue Recognition </b></i></span></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">The Company derives revenue from <em style="font: inherit;">three</em>&#160;primary sources: SaaS, term license and support, and services.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">SaaS revenue is recognized ratably over the term of the contract. Term&#160;license revenue includes distinct&#160;on-premises&#160;license and support performance obligations. The license is generally recognized upfront at the point in time when the software is made available to the customer to download and use, and the support is recognized ratably over the term&#160;of the contract.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">Services revenue includes revenue derived primarily from the implementation of software, training, consulting, and migrations. We also offer license customization and managed services. Services revenue from implementation, training, consulting, migration, and license customization is recognized by applying a measure of progress, such as labor hours to determine the percentage of completion of each contract. Services revenue from managed services is recognized ratably on a straight-line basis over the contract term.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">Term&#160;license&#160;revenue recognized at a point in time was&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c145100632" contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31_ProductOrServiceAxis-TermedLicenseAndSupportMember_TimingOfTransferOfGoodOrServiceAxis-TransferredAtPointInTimeMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">5.4</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million for the <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> months&#160;ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>, and&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c145100636" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-03-31_ProductOrServiceAxis-TermedLicenseAndSupportMember_TimingOfTransferOfGoodOrServiceAxis-TransferredAtPointInTimeMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">7.2</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million&#160;for the <em style="font: inherit;">three</em>&#160;months ended&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2025</em>.&#160;The remaining revenue amount is recognized over time.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">Accounts receivable, net, is inclusive of accounts receivable, and current unbilled receivables, net of allowance for credit losses. We record an unbilled receivable when revenue is recognized prior to invoicing. We have a well-established collection history from our direct and indirect sales. We periodically evaluate the collectability of our accounts receivable and provide an allowance for credit losses as necessary, based on the age of the receivable, expected payment ability, and collection experience.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">We record deferred revenue in the condensed consolidated balance sheets when cash is collected or invoiced before revenue is earned. Revenue recognized that was included&#160;in the deferred revenue balance at the beginning of the period was $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100640" contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityRevenueRecognized" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">72.1</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million&#160;for the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">three</em>&#160;months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">As of <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>, transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations, which includes deferred revenue and amounts that will be invoiced and recognized as revenue in future periods, was $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100652" contextRef="i_2026-03-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligation" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">542.5</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million, of which $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100654" contextRef="i_2026-03-31_ProductOrServiceAxis-SAASMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligation" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">463.3</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million&#160;is related to SaaS and term&#160;license and support revenue. We expect to recognize approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c145100656" contextRef="i_2026-03-31_RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligationExpectedTimingOfSatisfactionStartDateAxis-date.domain-2026-04-01" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligationPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">59</ix:nonFraction>%&#160;of the total transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations&#160;over the next <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c145100658">twelve</span> months and the remainder thereafter.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt; margin: 0pt;"></p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt; margin: 0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><i></i></b></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationOptionAndIncentivePlansPolicy" id="c145104517" escape="true"><p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Stock-Based Compensation</span></i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Stock-based compensation represents the cost related to stock-based awards granted to employees. To date, we have issued both stock options and restricted stock units. The Company measures&#160;stock-based compensation cost at the grant date based on the estimated fair value of the award and recognizes the cost ratably&#160;over the requisite service period, net of actual forfeitures in the period.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">We estimate the fair value of stock options using the Black-Scholes valuation model. The Black-Scholes model requires highly subjective assumptions in order to derive the inputs necessary to&#160;calculate the fair value of stock options. The Company calculates the expected term using the &#8220;simplified&#8221;&#160;method, which is the simple average of the vesting period and the contractual term. The simplified method is applied as the Company does <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> have sufficient&#160;historical data to provide a reasonable basis for an estimate of the expected term. Expected volatility is based on the historical and implied volatility of a group of peer entities over a similar expected term. Dividend yields are based upon historical dividend yields. Risk-free interest rates are based on the implied yields currently available on U.S. Treasury <em style="font: inherit;">zero</em> coupon issues with a remaining term equal to the expected term.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p></ix:nonNumeric><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"></p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><i></i></b></p><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" name="us-gaap:NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock" id="c145104518" escape="true"><p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Recent Accounting Pronouncements <em style="font: inherit;">Not</em> Yet Effective</span></i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">In&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> November 2024,&#160;</em>the FASB issued ASU&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">No.</em>&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">03,</em>&#160;&#8220;Income Statement &#8211; Reporting Comprehensive Income &#8211; Expense Disaggregation Disclosures (ASC&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">220</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">40</em>): Disaggregation of Income Statement Expenses&#8221; (&#8220;<b><i>ASU</i></b>&#160;<b><i><em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">03</em></i></b>&#8221;), and in&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> January 2025,&#160;</em>the FASB issued ASU&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">No.</em>&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">01,</em>&#160;&#8220;Income Statement &#8211; Reporting Comprehensive Income &#8211; Expense Disaggregation Disclosures (ASC&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">220</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">40</em>): Clarifying the Effective Date&#8221; (&#8220;<b><i>ASU</i></b>&#160;<b><i><em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">01</em></i></b>&#8221;). ASU&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">03</em>&#160;requires public entities to disclose additional information about specific expense categories in the notes to the financial statements. ASU&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">03,</em>&#160;as clarified by ASU&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">01,</em>&#160;is effective in annual reporting periods beginning after&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 15, 2026,&#160;</em>and interim periods within annual reporting periods beginning after&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 15, 2027</em><i>.</i>&#160;The amendments in this ASU&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> may&#160;</em>be applied either prospectively or retrospectively. Early adoption is also permitted. We are currently evaluating the impact ASU&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">03</em>&#160;will have on our consolidated financial statements and related disclosures.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> September 2025, </em>the FASB issued ASU <em style="font: inherit;">No.</em> <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">06,</em> &#8220;Intangibles - Goodwill and Other - Internal-Use Software (Subtopic <em style="font: inherit;">350</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">40</em>): Targeted Improvements to the Accounting for Internal-Use Software&#8221; (&#8220;<i><b>ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">06</em></b></i>&#8221;).&#160;ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">06</em> modernizes the capitalization criteria for internal-use software, eliminating references to project stages and instead requiring that projects meet completion probability criteria before costs can be capitalized. ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">06</em> is effective for annual periods beginning after <em style="font: inherit;"> December 15, 2027, </em>and interim periods within those annual periods. The amendments in this ASU <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be applied using a prospective, retrospective, or modified transition approach. Early adoption is also permitted. We are currently evaluating the impact ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">06</em>&#160;will have on our consolidated financial statements and related disclosures.&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">3.</em> Business Combination</b></p>

   <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; "><b><i>Mandatorily Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest</i></b></span></p>
   <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> January 29, 2025,&#160;</em>the Company consummated its acquisition of <ix:nonFraction id="c145100851" contextRef="i_2025-01-29_BusinessAcquisitionAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">80</ix:nonFraction>%&#160;of the outstanding shares of&#160;Ydentic Holding B.V., which owns <ix:nonFraction id="c145100853" contextRef="i_2025-01-29_LegalEntityAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember_OwnershipAxis-YdenticBVMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:MinorityInterestOwnershipPercentageByParent" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the outstanding equity interests of Ydentic B.V. (together, &#8220;<b><i>Ydentic</i></b>&#8221;). The acquisition&#160;was&#160;made pursuant to the Share Purchase Agreement, by and among the Company and the former Ydentic shareholders. The Company completed the acquisition of Ydentic to further expand its SaaS solutions for providing robust, simple, centralized multi-tenant management for&#160;managed service providers (&#8220;<i><b>MSPs</b></i>&#8221;) that utilize Microsoft solutions. As part of the acquisition, the Company agreed to purchase the remaining <ix:nonFraction id="c145100855" contextRef="i_2025-01-29_BusinessAcquisitionAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember_EquityInterestIssuedOrIssuableByTypeAxis-SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">20</ix:nonFraction>% of the outstanding shares of Ydentic. The unconditional purchase obligation is a liability-classified mandatorily redeemable noncontrolling interest with subsequent measurement at its estimated redemption value. The estimated fair value of the transaction consideration is&#160;approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100857" contextRef="d_2025-01-29_2025-01-29_BusinessAcquisitionAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember" unitRef="USD" name="avpt:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredAndToBeTransferred" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">20.4</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million, consisting of $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100859" contextRef="d_2025-01-29_2025-01-29_BusinessAcquisitionAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">14.9</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million in cash paid at closing and a $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100861" contextRef="d_2025-01-29_2025-01-29_BusinessAcquisitionAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember_EquityInterestIssuedOrIssuableByTypeAxis-SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredEquityInterestsIssuedAndIssuable" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">5.5</ix:nonFraction> million unconditional purchase obligation with variability in the timing and amount of settlement.</p>
   <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>, the liability was $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100863" contextRef="i_2026-03-31_BusinessAcquisitionAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember_EquityInterestIssuedOrIssuableByTypeAxis-SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettlementTermsAmountCurrent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">6.3</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million and&#160;is included&#160;in accrued expenses and other current liabilities within the condensed consolidated balance sheets. As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025, </em>the liability was $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100865" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_BusinessAcquisitionAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember_EquityInterestIssuedOrIssuableByTypeAxis-SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettlementTermsAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">6.2</ix:nonFraction> million, of which $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100867" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_BusinessAcquisitionAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember_EquityInterestIssuedOrIssuableByTypeAxis-SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettlementTermsAmountCurrent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.9</ix:nonFraction> million was included in accrued expenses and other current liabilities and $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100869" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_BusinessAcquisitionAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember_EquityInterestIssuedOrIssuableByTypeAxis-SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettlementTermsAmountNoncurrent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">4.3</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million was&#160;included in other liabilities within&#160;the condensed consolidated balance sheets. During the <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> months ended&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>&#160;and <em style="font: inherit;">2025,</em>&#160;the Company recorded interest expense&#160;of $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100876" contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31_BusinessAcquisitionAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember_EquityInterestIssuedOrIssuableByTypeAxis-SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember" unitRef="USD" name="avpt:ScheduleOfFinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionInterestIncomeExpense" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.2</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100878" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-03-31_BusinessAcquisitionAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember_EquityInterestIssuedOrIssuableByTypeAxis-SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember" unitRef="USD" name="avpt:ScheduleOfFinancialInstrumentsSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionInterestIncomeExpense" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.8</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively,&#160;to adjust the redemption value of the mandatorily redeemable noncontrolling interest. The interest expense&#160;is&#160;included in&#160;other&#160;income, net, within the condensed consolidated statements of income.</p>

   <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> April 2026, </em>the Company purchased <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c145100880">one</span> <em style="font: inherit;">third</em> of the remaining <ix:nonFraction id="c145100886" contextRef="i_2025-01-29_BusinessAcquisitionAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember_EquityInterestIssuedOrIssuableByTypeAxis-SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:BusinessAcquisitionPercentageOfVotingInterestsAcquired" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">20</ix:nonFraction>% of the outstanding shares of Ydentic for an aggregate cash purchase price of $<ix:nonFraction id="c145100888" contextRef="d_2026-04-01_2026-04-30_BusinessAcquisitionAxis-YdenticHoldingBvMember_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember" unitRef="USD" name="avpt:PaymentsToSettleBusinessAcquisitionLiability" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.8</ix:nonFraction> million.</p>

   <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">5.</em> Intangible Assets, Net</b></p>
   <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">Intangible assets consist of acquired intangible assets and self-developed software.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">7.</em> Line of Credit </b></p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">The Company maintains a loan and security agreement (the &#8220;<i><b>Loan Agreement</b></i>&#8221;) with HSBC Bank USA, National Association&#160;(&#8220;<i><b>HSBC</b></i>&#8221;), as lender, for a revolving line of credit of up to $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101051" contextRef="i_2023-11-03_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_LineOfCreditFacilityAxis-HSBCVentureBankUsaIncMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">30.0</ix:nonFraction> million, with an accordion feature that provides up to $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101053" contextRef="i_2023-11-03_CreditFacilityAxis-LineOfCreditAccordionFeatureMember_LineOfCreditFacilityAxis-HSBCVentureBankUsaIncMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">20.0</ix:nonFraction> million of additional borrowing capacity the Company <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>draw upon at its request. Of the <em style="font: inherit;">$30.0</em> million line of credit, a sublimit of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101057" contextRef="i_2023-11-03_CreditFacilityAxis-LineOfCreditAccordionFeatureMember_LineOfCreditFacilityAxis-HSBCVentureBankUsaIncMember" unitRef="USD" name="avpt:LineOfCreditFacilitySublimitOnMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">9.3</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million is designated to facilitate the issuance of bank guarantees, including letters of credit. The line bears&#160;interest at a rate equal to term <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c145101058">SOFR</span> plus <ix:nonFraction id="c145101059" contextRef="d_2023-11-03_2023-11-03_CreditFacilityAxis-LineOfCreditAccordionFeatureMember_LineOfCreditFacilityAxis-HSBCVentureBankUsaIncMember_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">3.0</ix:nonFraction>% to <ix:nonFraction id="c145101060" contextRef="d_2023-11-03_2023-11-03_CreditFacilityAxis-LineOfCreditAccordionFeatureMember_LineOfCreditFacilityAxis-HSBCVentureBankUsaIncMember_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">3.3</ix:nonFraction>% depending on the Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio (as defined in the Loan Agreement). The line carries&#160;an unused fee at a rate equal to <ix:nonFraction id="c145101061" contextRef="d_2023-11-03_2023-11-03_CreditFacilityAxis-LineOfCreditAccordionFeatureMember_LineOfCreditFacilityAxis-HSBCVentureBankUsaIncMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityUnusedCapacityCommitmentFeePercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">0.5</ix:nonFraction>%. The line will mature&#160;on <em style="font: inherit;"> November 3, 2026. </em>The Company is&#160;required to maintain a minimum Consolidated Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio (as defined in the Loan Agreement) as well as a maximum Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio, tested by HSBC each quarter. The Company pledged, assigned and granted HSBC&#160;a security interest in all shares of its subsidiaries, future proceeds and assets (except for excluded assets, including material intellectual property) as security for the performance of the Loan Agreement obligations. As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>, the Company is compliant with all covenants and had <ix:nonFraction id="c145101062" contextRef="i_2026-03-31_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_LineOfCreditFacilityAxis-HSBCVentureBankUsaIncMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LineOfCredit" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="-3">no</ix:nonFraction> borrowings outstanding under the Loan Agreement.</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -36pt; text-indent: 36pt;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">8.</em> Income Taxes</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">The Company had an effective tax rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c145101069" contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateContinuingOperations" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">7.8</ix:nonFraction>%&#160;for&#160;the <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>, and&#160;<ix:nonFraction id="c145101073" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-03-31" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateContinuingOperations" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">26.8</ix:nonFraction>%&#160;for the <em style="font: inherit;">three</em>&#160;months ended&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2025</em>.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">The change in effective tax rates for the <em style="font: inherit;">three</em>-month period ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em> as compared to the <em style="font: inherit;">three</em>-month period ended&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2025</em>&#160;was primarily due to the mix of pre-tax income results by jurisdictions&#160;taxed at different rates, the impact of foreign inclusions and&#160;stock-based compensation.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -30pt; text-indent: 18pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">The Company continues to evaluate the realizability of its deferred tax assets on a quarterly basis and will adjust such amounts in light of changing facts and circumstances. In making such an assessment, management would consider all available supporting data, including the level of historical taxable income, future reversals of existing temporary differences, tax planning strategies, and projected future taxable income.&#160;While we currently have a full valuation allowance recorded on the U.S. net deferred tax assets, future results,&#160;combined with other positive or negative evidence, <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>require the Company to re-assess the valuation allowance recorded on its U.S. net deferred tax assets in future periods.</p>

   <p style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">(1)</sup> Short-term lease expenses include rent expenses from leases of <em style="font: inherit;">12</em> months or less on the transition date or lease commencement.</p>

    <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
    <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">Our lease agreements generally contain lease and non-lease components. Non-lease components primarily include payments for maintenance and utilities. We elected to combine fixed payments for non-lease components, for all classes of underlying assets, with our lease payments and account for them together as a single lease component, which increases the amount of our lease assets and liabilities.</p>
    <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">10.</em> Commitments and Contingencies</b></p>
   <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><b><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Commitments</span></i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">The Company has outstanding unconditional purchase commitments to procure licenses to use information technology (&#8220;<b><i>IT</i></b>&#8221;) software from suppliers. These agreements are negotiated in consideration of the volume of transactions with select suppliers and the associated required transaction volumes are expected to be met through the normal course of business.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">In&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 2024,&#160;</em>the Company signed an unconditional purchase commitment in the amount of $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101198" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationByCategoryOfItemPurchasedAxis-ITSolutionsMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationBalanceSheetAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">15.0</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million to purchase IT&#160;solutions over a&#160;<span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c145101200">five</span>-year term. Under this agreement, payments are made upon access to the service. The agreement specified&#160;<span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c145101202">four</span>&#160;minimum commitment periods. The minimum commitment payments are&#160;due at the end of each minimum commitment period. During the <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2025,</em> the Company paid $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101205" contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31_UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationByCategoryOfItemPurchasedAxis-ITSolutionsMember" unitRef="USD" name="avpt:PaymentsForUnconditionalPurchaseCommitment" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.2</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101206" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-03-31_UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationByCategoryOfItemPurchasedAxis-ITSolutionsMember" unitRef="USD" name="avpt:PaymentsForUnconditionalPurchaseCommitment" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-3">0.0</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively, related to the <em style="font: inherit;"> December 2024 </em>agreement.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> December 2025, </em>the Company entered into a <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c145101207">five</span>-year agreement under which the Company committed to consume $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101208" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationByCategoryOfItemPurchasedAxis-ITServicesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationBalanceSheetAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">340.0</ix:nonFraction> million of eligible IT services from <em style="font: inherit;"> December 1, 2025 </em>through <em style="font: inherit;"> November 30, 2030. </em>The agreement includes a Year <em style="font: inherit;">1</em> minimum consumption milestone of $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101212" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_StatementScenarioAxis-Year1MinimumConsumptionMilestoneMember_UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationByCategoryOfItemPurchasedAxis-ITServicesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationBalanceSheetAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">50.0</ix:nonFraction> million, for which the vendor <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>invoice the Company for any shortfall as a prepayment that will be applied against future consumption. During the <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026, </em>the Company paid $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101216" contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31_UnrecordedUnconditionalPurchaseObligationByCategoryOfItemPurchasedAxis-ITServicesMember" unitRef="USD" name="avpt:PaymentsForUnconditionalPurchaseCommitment" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">20.0</ix:nonFraction> million related to the <em style="font: inherit;"> December 2025 </em>agreement.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> February 2024, </em>the Company made a commitment to contribute $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101218" contextRef="i_2024-02-28_OtherCommitmentsAxis-GrowthEquityFundMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OtherCommitment" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">50.0</ix:nonFraction> million to a growth equity fund.    <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">Pursuant to the Company&#8217;s Third Amended and Restated Certificate of&#160;Incorporation, the Company is&#160;authorized to issue up to <ix:nonFraction id="c145101260" contextRef="i_2026-03-31" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:CommonStockSharesAuthorized" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">1,000,000,000</ix:nonFraction> shares of common stock at $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101262" contextRef="i_2026-03-31" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">0.0001</ix:nonFraction> par value. There were <ix:nonFraction id="c145101264" contextRef="i_2026-03-31" unitRef="Share" name="avpt:CommonStockSharesIssuedIncludingTreasuryShares" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">211,853,736</ix:nonFraction>&#160;and <ix:nonFraction id="c145101266" contextRef="i_2025-12-31" unitRef="Share" name="avpt:CommonStockSharesIssuedIncludingTreasuryShares" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">215,076,033</ix:nonFraction> shares issued and outstanding as of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>&#160;and <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, respectively. Purchases made pursuant to the Share Repurchase Program <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be conducted in compliance with Exchange Act Rule <em style="font: inherit;">10b</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">18</em> and/or Exchange Act Rule <em style="font: inherit;">10b5</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">1.</em> Any purchases made pursuant to the Share Repurchase Program are to&#160;be conducted in compliance with all other applicable legal, regulatory, and internal policy requirements, including our Insider Trading Policy.&#160;We are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> obligated to make purchases of, nor are we obligated to acquire any particular amount of, common stock under the Share Purchase Program.    <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">12.</em> Growth Equity Fund</b></p>
   <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> February 28, 2024, </em>the Company and Lumens Capital Partners Ltd. (&#8220;<b><i>LCP</i></b>&#8221;) established <em style="font: inherit;">A3V</em> JV Co. (the &#8220;<b><i>Venture</i></b>&#8221;), with each owning an equal share of the Venture.&#160;In addition, the Company entered into a separate agreement with LCP to form <em style="font: inherit;">A3</em> Ventures Fund <em style="font: inherit;">1,</em> L.P. (the &#8220;<b><i>Fund</i></b>&#8221;), a Cayman Islands-exempted limited partnership, aimed at investing in companies in the growth equity phase and mature cashflow generating businesses with strong growth potential.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">The Venture wholly owns <em style="font: inherit;">A3V</em> GP Co., which serves&#160;as the general partner of the Fund. As a limited partner, the Company committed to contribute $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101363" contextRef="d_2024-02-28_2024-02-28_ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis-A3VenturesFund1LpMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:VariableInterestEntityFinancialOrOtherSupportAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">50.0</ix:nonFraction> million to the Fund, to be called as needed, for portfolio investments, fees, and expenses of the Fund. The Company also participates in Fund establishment costs and an annual management fee equal to <ix:nonFraction id="c145101365" contextRef="i_2024-02-28_ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis-A3VenturesFund1LpMember" unitRef="Pure" name="avpt:ManagementFeePercentOfTotalCommitment" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">2.0</ix:nonFraction>% of the total commitment. Any future repayment obligations will be triggered upon the receipt by LCP of profit allocations related to the Fund.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">In <em style="font: inherit;"> September&#160;</em><em style="font: inherit;">2025,</em> the Company decided to discontinue its participation in the Fund.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>, <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> portion of the Company&#8217;s $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101371" contextRef="d_2026-01-01_2026-03-31_ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis-A3VenturesFund1LpMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:VariableInterestEntityFinancialOrOtherSupportAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">50.0</ix:nonFraction> million commitment has been called or was callable.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>&#160;and <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025, </em>an estimated payable of $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101373" contextRef="i_2026-03-31_ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis-A3VenturesFund1LpMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ManagementFeePayable" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.6</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c145101375" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis-A3VenturesFund1LpMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ManagementFeePayable" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.6</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively, were included in accrued expenses and other current liabilities in the condensed consolidated balance sheets.</p>

   <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; "><b>Restricted Stock Units</b></span></i></p>
   <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">Under the terms of the <em style="font: inherit;">2021</em> Plan, we have issued restricted stock unit&#160;awards with a continuous employment condition only (&#8220;<i><b>Time-Based RSUs</b></i>&#8221;), and restricted stock unit awards with a continuous employment condition that are also contingent on the Company meeting certain performance goals that <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be higher or lower than the granted amount (&#8220;<i><b>PSUs</b></i>&#8221;, and together with Time-Based RSUs, &#8220;<i><b>RSUs</b></i>&#8221;). Both types of RSU awards vest over periods determined at the time of grant either ratably or along a cliff vesting.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">The compensation costs for RSUs are recognized using the straight-line attribution method over the requisite service period. Forfeitures&#160;are accounted for&#160;as they occur.&#160;RSUs&#160;are&#160;measured at the fair market value of the underlying stock at the grant date.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">A summary of the Company&#8217;s RSU activity during the <em style="font: inherit;">three</em>&#160;months ended <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, 2026</em>&#160;is as follows:</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">15.</em> Segment Information</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">The Company manages its business activities on a consolidated basis and operates&#160;in a <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c145101825"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c145101827">single</span></span> operating segment. Its products and services are sold throughout the world, through direct and indirect sales channels. The Company&#8217;s chief operating decision maker (the &#8220;<b><i>CODM</i></b>&#8221;) is the Chief Executive Officer. The CODM makes operating performance assessment and resource allocation decisions on a consolidated basis. The CODM does&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">not</em>&#160;review&#160;assets in evaluating the results of the segment.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">The CODM assesses performance for the consolidated entity and decides how to allocate resources based on net income&#160;reported on the condensed consolidated statements of income. The CODM uses net income to monitor budgeted versus actual results and to conduct competitive analysis by benchmarking against industry peers. Additionally, net income&#160;serves as a basis for making strategic decisions, such as acquisitions and reinvestments into the business, and establishing management compensation linked to segment performance.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">17.</em> Net Income&#160;Per Share </b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 36pt;">Basic net income per share&#160;is computed by dividing total net income&#160;by the weighted average&#160;common shares outstanding for the period. In computing diluted net income per share,&#160;the Company adjusts the denominator, subject to anti-dilution requirements, to include the dilution from potential shares of common stock resulting from outstanding share-based payment awards and&#160;warrants.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

    </tr>

    <tr style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
     <td style="width: 18pt; border-left: 1px solid rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</td>

  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;"><i><span style="text-decoration: underline; "><b>Overview </b></span></i></p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">AvePoint is a global provider of modern data protection, enabling organizations to secure, govern, and operationalize data at scale across major cloud ecosystems. Customers rely on the AvePoint Confidence Platform to reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and accelerate digital transformation as they adopt cloud collaboration and artificial intelligence (&#8220;<i><b>AI</b></i>&#8221;)-driven advanced tools and workflows.&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">As organizations embed AI into core business processes, data becomes both a strategic asset and a growing source of risk. AI can amplify the impact of poor data hygiene, including sensitive data exposure, compliance failures, and operational disruption. Enterprises increasingly require a modern data foundation where data is discoverable, classified, governed, protected, and recoverable by design.</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">Our solutions are designed to address four pervasive and interconnected enterprise data challenges:</p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt;">
   <tbody>
    <tr style="vertical-align: top; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
     <td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</td>
     <td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; vertical-align: middle;"> <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 6pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;">&#9632;</p> </td>
     <td style="width: auto; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"> <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Legacy and fragmented data that limits visibility, governance, and AI readiness;</p> </td>
    </tr>

    <tr style="vertical-align: top; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
     <td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</td>
     <td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; vertical-align: middle;"> <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 6pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt;">&#9632;</p> </td>
     <td style="width: auto; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Overexposed data that increases security, privacy, and regulatory risk;</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
     <td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</td>
     <td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 6pt; padding: 0pt; vertical-align: middle;">&#9632;</td>
     <td style="width: auto; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif;">Digital sprawl that drives operational complexity and rising total cost of ownership; and</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
     <td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</td>
     <td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 6pt; padding: 0pt; vertical-align: middle;">&#9632;</td>
     <td style="width: auto; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif;">Data loss and interruption, which threaten business continuity and organizational resilience.&#160;</td>
    </tr>

   </tbody>
  </table>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:36pt;">By addressing these challenges through an integrated platform, we enable organizations to reduce risk, lower complexity, and accelerate time-to-value from their data.</p>

     <td style="vertical-align: top; width: 81px;"> <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Annual Recurring Revenue</span></p> </td>
     <td style="vertical-align: top; width: 4px;">&#160;</td>
     <td style="vertical-align: top; width: 616px;"> <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">We believe ARR further enables measurement of our business performance, is an important metric for financial forecasting, and better enables us to make strategic business&#160;decisions.&#160;We calculate&#160;ARR&#160;as the annualized sum of contractually obligated Annual Contract Value (&#8220;<b><i>ACV</i></b>&#8221;) from SaaS and term license and support&#160;sources from all active customers at the end of a reporting period.</p> <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p> <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt;">As of March 31, 2026&#160;and March 31, 2025, total&#160;ARR was $435.2&#160;million and&#160;$345.5 million, respectively, representing growth of 26%&#160;year over year, and 23% when adjusted for FX.</p> <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p> <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt;">Growth in ARR is driven by both new customer acquisitions and the expansion of existing customer relationships. ARR should be viewed independently of revenue and deferred revenue and is not intended to be combined with or replace these items. ARR is not a forecast of future revenue, and the active contracts used in calculating ARR may or may not be extended or renewed by our customers.</p> </td>
    </tr>
